images.caption: Douglasbrae,Keith. This a registered knackery near Keith.In the north and east of Scotland the discreet red lorries belonging to the factory are seen taking carcasses for destruction. In the foreground is the single track line belong to Keith & Dufftown Railway Association. The railway has been restored and trains run in the summer months.
